subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw adopt third-party passive-capture exports as a supported core compatibility contract, and which producer/version should define the initial boundary?
rationale: The code can be extended mechanically once the boundary is selected, but repository evidence cannot determine how much external schema drift and semantic ambiguity maintainers intend core Birdclaw to own.

options.title: Scrollmark v1 only
options.body: Support only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 initially and require separate evidence and review before adding legacy or twitter-web-exporter adapters.

options.title: Broad capture adapters
options.body: Define a generic capture-import framework now and ship Scrollmark canonical, legacy Scrollmark, and twitter-web-exporter detection together with a larger compatibility surface.

options.title: External conversion path
options.body: Keep core import limited to official archives and Birdclaw backups, documenting an external converter that produces a supported Birdclaw-owned interchange format.

recommendation.title: Scrollmark v1 only
recommendation.body: Support only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 initially and require separate evidence and review before adding legacy or twitter-web-exporter adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: The archive importer, canonical persistence boundary, and current product vision are primarily connected to their repository history.
